checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=24 breakdowns=8 bursts_in_base=3 giveback=1.16 tightness=0.81 base_volume_vs_leg=0.68 base_volume_vs_avg=0.83
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 24 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; 8 4% breakdowns inside the base; the base gave back 1.16 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 2.1% vs its 20-SMA, -15.8% over 20 sessions
gain of 15.64% is 15% or more: the worst cell in the only event study, a 36% win rate and -9.3% at 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 2 of 3 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The C check is a hard FAIL with 8 breakdowns inside a 24-session base, a giveback of 1.16 (the base returned more than the entire prior leg gain), and 3 bursts inside the base — the chart confirms this: the shaded consolidation region from early October through early November shows wide, overlapping red and green bars with repeated large swings, not the shallow orderly drift Bonde requires. The base is visibly a declining, choppy structure rather than a tight consolidation, and the 15.64% burst day gain sits in the worst event-study cell (36% win rate, -9.3% at 20 sessions). These combined defects make the plan wrong.
claude.key_risk: A deeply failed consolidation with 8 internal breakdowns and full giveback of the prior leg means there is no orderly base to burst from, and the large gap component of the signal day reduces follow-through probability further.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above the burst close or if the first 30 minutes show a fade back below the prior day's close near $5.82.
